title: Same Digits, Different Values — Decimals
note: Exact grids represent amounts; cartoons provide context only and are not scale drawings. In the sorting pictures, all ten small hundred-grids together form one whole of 1,000 equal cells. Enlarge images to inspect single cells. Colored cells are read left to right within each small grid, then through the top row of grids before the bottom row.
provider: Built-in image generation and deterministic SVG diagrams
style: Text-free cartoons and mathematically exact diagrams
